description: Fixed retrieval queries with a known relevant work (Unit 6 feedback #2: 'clear, measurable targets, including the test queries'). The targets are papers cited in the Unit 6 design report, so the test asks: can ScholarPlan find the literature its own design relied on? A hit means the work appears among the records returned by arXiv, OpenAlex and Crossref (5 per API) for the query.
